components.text:
Strikes every undead creature within 8 blocks of the centre with holy damage (8 by default, 4 hearts). It hits Tensura undead and vanilla undead.

Anyone can perform it. Tensura must be installed.

It does not tell friend from foe: undead allies within 8 blocks are hit too, and the reach is wider than the circle.

Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.
